create_pushworld_puzzle: create a PushWorldPuzzle from a .pwp file path to load a puzzle definition
run_pushworld_plan: run a sequence of actions on a PushWorldPuzzle and verify the plan achieves the goal
render_pushworld_state: render a PushWorldPuzzle state as an RGB numpy image array
